name: August Fan Box
source: This is a fandisk for August games Binary Pot,  Princess Holiday and Tsuki wa Higashi ni Hi wa Nishi ni: Operation Sanctuary. Featuring characters from those games with new stories to play as well as puzzle games and related fan material.
